platform_info.name: WhatsApp account information
platform_info.description: Handles the WhatsApp account information export (zip with JSON/HTML files). Extracts the number of contacts, the number of groups and the device platform (iphone/android).

description.en: In this table you can see: the number of groups you are a part of, the number of contacts you have, and the platform you use WhatsApp on.
description.nl: In deze tabel zie je: het aantal groepen waar je lid van bent, het aantal contacten dat je hebt, en het platform waarop je WhatsApp gebruikt.

documentation.summary: One row per available statistic about the participant's WhatsApp account: number of contacts, number of groups, and the device platform.

columns.Value: Value of the statistic (a count, or iphone/android for the platform).
